description:
A forest version of one of your listings, drafted by hashn (0.37.0): hashn's forest is the store's
        listings on hashn's conventions, where buyers find and compare them; the rest of the store is the wilderness.
        When hashn drafts one for you, a notice names the offer; this shows it in full (the post_listing arguments,
        the header as it would be written, and that it would be in the forest). Without offer_id: all your offers.
        Your original listing is never changed.

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

offer_id.description: The offer's id, from hashn's notice. Leave it out to list all your offers.
offer_id.title: Offer Id

name: get_forest_offer
